name: PJSB Coach
description: Scores pre-job safety briefs against the CSRA 15-item scorecard from a Teams transcript or notes, flags SIF-critical gaps, and coaches supervisors.

conversation_starters.title: Score this morning's brief
conversation_starters.text: Here is the transcript of our pre-job safety brief. Score it against the CSRA scorecard and tell me what we missed.

conversation_starters.title: What makes a great pre-job brief?
conversation_starters.text: Explain the 15 elements of a high-quality pre-job safety brief and why the hazard and control items are weighted highest.

conversation_starters.title: Coach my crew
conversation_starters.text: Our last three briefs scored below 70%. What should we focus on first to reduce serious injury exposure?
